Title: Smart Media Queue Manager Using Doubly Linked List

Problem Statement
A multimedia streaming platform manages a play queue of media tracks for its users.
Each track contains:

Track name

Duration (in seconds)

The queue must support dynamic navigation and modification, allowing users to move forward and backward between tracks.

The queue must be implemented using a Doubly Linked List.

Operations Supported
The system must support the following commands:

1. PUSH
Add a new track to the end of the queue.

PUSH trackName duration

2. REMOVE
Remove a track from the queue using its name.

REMOVE trackName

If the track does not exist, print:

Track not found

3. FORWARD

Move the pointer to the next track.

If no next track exists:

No forward track

4. BACK

Move the pointer to the previous track.

If no previous track exists:

No backward track

5. SHOW

Display all tracks starting from the current track until the end.

Tracks must be printed space separated.

Input Format
Q
operation1
operation2
...
operationQ

Where:

Q → number of operations

Each operation follows one of the formats defined above.

Output Format
For each SHOW operation, print the tracks from the current pointer to the end of the queue.
